title: My navigation was not talking to me 🚗
style_prompt: dark blue cinematic night, faceless silhouette, fog, minimal interior, no text, no watermark
hook_text: At 11:40 in the evening my navigation told me to turn left.

scenes.narration: At 11:40 in the evening my navigation told me to turn left.
There was no left turn. Just fog, one street lamp, and a wet road.
I kept driving. It said it again. Turn left. Calm. Patient. As if it knew I had no choice.
I took the turn. A ramp, down into an underground car park I had never seen. Every space empty. One car far away, headlights on.
The voice said, you have arrived. The engine stopped. I had not touched anything.
I stepped out. An elevator stood open at the end of the hall. Light inside. Waiting. Not for me.
The doors closed behind me. I had not pressed anything. It rose. The roof. City lights through the fog.
I looked back at my car, far below. The back seat. The leather was pressed down. As if someone had been sitting there all evening.
Then, behind me, very close, a quiet voice said, thank you for the ride.
So tell me. Do you turn around, or keep looking at the lights?
